question: Do the original finite-strip fibre semigroups Q_n(t) in the R-514 stationary state converge on every declared cylinder pair to the R-568/R-512 minimal Markov semigroup in the R-510 Hilbert space, uniformly on compact external Markov-time intervals, with j before the anchored n limit?

exact_scope.model: Exactly PAH-001 with the original directed PH/LK/AP/TR rates, labelled all-Q Gibbs law and two-row OMC-004 strip.
exact_scope.parameters: K=2, M_s=1, epsilon=1/2, beta=nu=1, m2=theta=0 and all remaining displayed OMC-016 couplings one.
exact_scope.boundary: The terminal unsplit square and all original frontier terms are retained; no split-cell replacement or conditional boundary average is allowed.
exact_scope.states: nu_n is the R-510 fixed-n labelled stationary state and mu is the R-510 anchored local state, obtained with j->infinity first at each fixed n.
exact_scope.domain: D is exactly the R-511 bounded gauge-invariant globally amplitude-l1-Lipschitz finite-prefix cylinder algebra, including constants.
exact_scope.time: The original external unaccelerated Markov time t>=0; no quantum, proper or Lorentzian interpretation.
exact_scope.order: First j->infinity at fixed n, then amplitude cutoff removal, then anchored n->infinity. No diagonal or reversed limit.
exact_scope.target: T_min is the R-512/R-567 minimal conservative Markov extension on H=L2(mu), with R-568 uniqueness conditional on a semigroup already existing on that same H and extending R-511 A.

required_bridges.N2a: A source-authorized bounded-energy or equivalent U_n from the finite nu_n space into the same H, preserving local cylinders and the unsplit terminal square.
required_bridges.N2b: Arbitrary-sequence form liminf and recovery after the U_n identification.
required_bridges.N2c_N4: A compact-time boundary-escape or generator-residual estimate for the original unbounded finite-strip rates, uniform in n after local support is fixed.
required_bridges.N2d: Identification of the resulting limit with the R-512 minimal closure rather than only an arbitrary Markov extension.
required_bridges.tails: A source-derived amplitude-tail estimate compatible with the same n-uniform comparison, not only fixed-n tails or the target mu tail.

acceptance: PROVED only if all required bridges yield the displayed correlation limit for every f,g in D and finite T, with primary, independent and hostile evidence.
DISPROVED only if an exact PAH source observable or source-authorized family violates the displayed limit or the R-512 minimal identification.
HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE if the objects are source-compatible but one required bridge remains unproved; record the single missing statement and re-entry condition.
Lean may formalize algebraic error decompositions and implication lemmas, but may not treat an assumed U_n or Mosco theorem as proved.
prohibited: No new Hamiltonian, carrier, rates, mobility, state, projection, counterterm, time scale, boundary condition or limit order.
No inference from R-568 uniqueness, R-510 static convergence or R-514 fixed-n passage alone.
No Q3LOCK, TECT-YM, physical Pre-A, QFT, gravity, continuum, Yang-Mills, mass-gap or TOE conclusion.
bounded_attempt: One source/domain compatibility and ordered-limit bridge attempt. Do not repeat owner scans or finite tables; after this attempt enter REVIEW_REQUIRED with the exact missing bridge if the limit does not close.
